newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH FINMIN TAKES OVER AGROBANKA A-INVEST - AGENCY.
newsitem.headline: CZECH FINMIN TAKES OVER AGROBANKA A-INVEST - AGENCY.

text.p: The Czech Finance Ministry has put A-invest, the investment arm of Czech bank Agrobanka a.s., under forced administration, the CTK agency reported on Wednesday quoting a finance ministry regulator.
It said that Jan Motycka was appointed to manage A-invest for the Finance Ministry. Further details were not yet available, and Finance Ministry officials were not immediately available for comment.
In December the ministry put the investment fund AGB IF 2, a major shareholder of Agrobanka a.s., under forced administration, but few details of the action have been disclosed.
In the summer, the Czech National Bank put Agrobanka itself under what the central bank called "temporary forced adiminstration" with liquidity problems.
The fifth largest Czech bank is still under control of the central bank, which is currently organising a tender in search of a strategic partner to take a controlling interest in the Agrobanka.
